{{Quote|We lost Urlik! A Delta-7 has entered the battle.''"<br />"''Indeed.|A Valahari pilot and the Jedi, as the latter enters the battle of Valahari|<ref name="HotC1" />}}
A '''Mon Calamari Jedi''' participated in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Early in the war, in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], they were in charge of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Valahari/Legends|Valahari]], operating from the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Majestic (Venator-class)|''Majestic'']]. Not long after the establishment of the blockade, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] forces were [[Second battle of Valahari|attacked]] by the people of Valahari, led by the [[Ace/Legends|ace]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Tofen Vane/Legends|Tofen Vane]] of the royal [[House of Vane]]. The [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] flew a [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] into battle but was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when Vane damaged their [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and tossed it into the ''Majestic''{{'s}} [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] with a [[Power harpoon launcher|tow cable]]. All Republic forces were destroyed as well, except for one [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] that was allowed to flee.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I'm hit. Flame suppressors are out&hellip;''gahk''&hellip;need assistance&hellip;|The Jedi, after being hit by Tofen Vane|<ref name="HotC1" />}}
A [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] was a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="HotC1" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="HotC date" /> the Republic established a [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Valahari/Legends|Valahari]], after the planet's royal [[House of Vane]] refused to stop selling military technology to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The Mon Calamari was placed in charge of the blockade, commanding from the [[Majestic (Venator-class)|''Majestic'']], one of the three [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] stationed at Valahari. Soon, however, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] forces were [[Second battle of Valahari|attacked]] by a force of Valahari [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] led by [[Tofen Vane/Legends|Tofen Vane]], an [[Ace/Legends|ace]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and the heir to the House of Vane. Tofen believed that the Republic had been responsible for the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his father, [[Harko Vane]], in an earlier [[Battle of Valahari|skirmish]]<ref name="HotC1" />&mdash;though this in fact had been secretly orchestrated by the Confederacy in order to sway the Valahari to their side<ref name="HotC2">[[The Clone Wars 11|''The Clone Wars'' 11]]</ref>&mdash;and sought to liberate his planet from the Republic control.<ref name="HotC1" />

[[File:Mon_Cal_Jedi_death.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Mon Calamari is killed by Tofen Vane.]]
The Republic's [[Blue Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] was the first to fall under attack, and all of its members were quickly killed except for [[Blue Six (Galactic Republic)|Blue Six]]. The latter managed to inform the Mon Calamari of the approaching enemy fighters before his [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]] was shot down as well. As the Valahari harassed the Republic [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], Vane picked off the remaining V-19s. At this point, the Mon Calamari joined the battle, leaving the ''Majestic'' in a [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]]. The Jedi was able to kill the Valahari pilot [[Urlik]] before Vane caught on.<ref name="HotC1" />

Vane damaged the Jedi's craft with a rear-facing [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]], engulfing it in flames. The Jedi was unable to put out the fire, since its flame suppressors had also failed. As the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] began to fill with smoke, the Mon Calamari requested assistance. However, before any help could arrive, Vane used a [[Power harpoon launcher|tow cable]] to swing the disabled starfighter into the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the ''Majestic'', and the Jedi died upon impact. Vane's men destroyed all Republic forces, allowing only one [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] with [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to escape and spread the news that the Valahari had joined the Confederacy.<ref name="HotC1" />

==Personality and traits==
The Jedi had [[Color/Legends|brown]] skin and [[Eye/Legends|eye]] color.<ref name="HotC1" />

==Equipment==
The Mon Calamari wore tan-colored [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]].<ref name="HotC1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi appeared in [[The Clone Wars 10|''The Clone Wars'' 10]], a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] written by [[Henry Gilroy]] and [[Steven Melching]], illustrated by [[Brian Koschak]], and released by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="HotC1" /> on [[November 11]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/16-241/Star-Wars-The-Clone-Wars-10----Hero-of-the-Confederacy-part-1|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars #10 &mdash; Hero of the Confederacy part 1}}</ref>
